game.name: The Alchemist's Apothecary
game.description: A magical alchemy system built around experimentation, discovery, environmental events, references, and emergent combinations.

water.name: Water
water.description: Ordinary water that becomes extraordinary when introduced to the right ingredients.

nightleaf.name: Nightleaf
nightleaf.description: A dark leaf that opens only after sunset and absorbs a little moonlight.

glowcap.name: Glowcap
glowcap.description: A mushroom whose cap emits a gentle light without producing noticeable heat.

emberroot.name: Emberroot
emberroot.description: A root that remains warm long after being removed from the soil.

frostpetal.name: Frostpetal
frostpetal.description: A crystalline petal that lowers the temperature of nearby liquids.

starbloom.name: Starbloom
starbloom.description: A flower whose petals resemble tiny windows into a star-filled sky.

sunberry.name: Sunberry
sunberry.description: A warm golden berry that tastes faintly of honey and sunlight.

shadowmoss.name: Shadowmoss
shadowmoss.description: Moss that seems to occupy the darkness rather than merely grow within it.

silverthorn.name: Silverthorn
silverthorn.description: A thorny silver plant valued for its ability to reinforce protective mixtures.

moonwater.name: Moonwater
moonwater.description: Water collected under direct moonlight that retains a faint silver shimmer.

firefly_dust.name: Firefly Dust
firefly_dust.description: A glittering powder collected from naturally shed firefly scales.

dragon_scale.name: Dragon Scale
dragon_scale.description: A naturally shed scale from a dragon, retaining a stubborn resistance to heat.

crystal_shard.name: Crystal Shard
crystal_shard.description: A clear shard that amplifies nearby magical patterns.

dream_mushroom.name: Dream Mushroom
dream_mushroom.description: A mushroom that grows where sleepers repeatedly dream of the same place.

void_salt.name: Void Salt
void_salt.description: Black crystalline salt that seems to make nearby matter slightly less certain.

aether_dust.name: Aether Dust
aether_dust.description: Fine particulate aether collected from places where magical pressure is unusually high.

phoenix_ash.name: Phoenix Ash
phoenix_ash.description: Ash carrying a persistent regenerative resonance from a legendary firebird.

mermaid_tears.name: Mermaid Tears
mermaid_tears.description: Pearlescent tears with unusually strong restorative and emotional resonance.

ghost_essence.name: Ghost Essence
ghost_essence.description: A translucent residue left behind when a spirit briefly overlaps the physical world.

iron_dust.name: Iron Dust
iron_dust.description: Fine iron filings useful for grounding volatile magical mixtures.

rich_soil.name: Rich Soil
rich_soil.description: Deep dark soil saturated with nutrients and minor ambient magic.

honey.name: Honey
honey.description: Golden honey that acts as a surprisingly effective binding agent.

rose_petal.name: Rose Petal
rose_petal.description: A fragrant petal often used to carry emotional or restorative properties.

lavender.name: Lavender
lavender.description: A calming herb useful for reducing volatile mental effects.

peppermint.name: Peppermint
peppermint.description: A sharp herb that produces a cooling sensation and improves concentration.

gold_dust.name: Gold Dust
gold_dust.description: Fine gold particles prized for stabilizing value and transmutation mixtures.

obsidian_shard.name: Obsidian Shard
obsidian_shard.description: Volcanic glass that holds a quiet affinity for shadow and containment.

thunder_seed.name: Thunder Seed
thunder_seed.description: A seed-shaped knot of compressed electrical potential.

cloud_cotton.name: Cloud Cotton
cloud_cotton.description: Soft material harvested from the lowest edges of enchanted clouds.

unicorn_horn.name: Unicorn Horn
unicorn_horn.description: A pristine magical horn whose resonance strongly rejects contamination.

beetle_eyes.name: Beetle Eyes
beetle_eyes.description: Small preserved eyes prized for strange optical transformations.

boomslang_skin.name: Boomslang Skin
boomslang_skin.description: Shed serpent material with a strong affinity for adaptive transformations.

mandrake_root.name: Mandrake Root
mandrake_root.description: A magically resonant root whose cry-like vibration can disturb spiritual mixtures.

bezoar.name: Bezoar
bezoar.description: A dense mineralized organ material that neutralizes certain harmful alchemical effects.

serpent_fang.name: Serpent Fang
serpent_fang.description: A venom-bearing fang useful for dangerous transformation experiments.

chameleon_skin.name: Chameleon Skin
chameleon_skin.description: A color-shifting skin fragment capable of carrying adaptive visual properties.

phoenix_feather.name: Phoenix Feather
phoenix_feather.description: A luminous feather carrying a cyclical life-force resonance.

four_leaf_clover.name: Four-Leaf Clover
four_leaf_clover.description: A rare clover that subtly bends favorable outcomes toward the brewer.

five_leaf_clover.name: Five-Leaf Clover
five_leaf_clover.description: A corrupted clover that consumes magical structure and replaces certainty with hostile irregularity.

cursed_finger.name: Cursed Finger
cursed_finger.description: A deeply corrupted relic that dramatically amplifies unstable curse-based reactions.

black_flash_residue.name: Black Flash Residue
black_flash_residue.description: A compressed residue of precisely timed magical impact.

simple_domain_seal.name: Simple Domain Seal
simple_domain_seal.description: A compact geometric seal designed to dampen hostile magical influence.

binding_vow.name: Binding Vow
binding_vow.description: A contractual magical construct that trades one brewing advantage for another.

reverse_energy_fragment.name: Reverse Energy Fragment
reverse_energy_fragment.description: A fragment whose energy pattern converts destructive resonance into restorative output.

domain_fragment.name: Domain Fragment
domain_fragment.description: A fragment of a self-contained magical space with unusually strong boundary behavior.

six_eyes_lens.name: Six Eyes Lens
six_eyes_lens.description: An impossible optical relic capable of revealing hidden energetic inefficiencies.

heavenly_restriction_shard.name: Heavenly Restriction Shard
heavenly_restriction_shard.description: A strange shard that trades magical capacity for concentrated physical and material potency.

fallen_star_shard.name: Fallen Star Shard
fallen_star_shard.description: A fragment of celestial matter that fell during a meteor shower.

moonshadow.name: Moonshadow
moonshadow.description: A shadow detached from ordinary geometry during an eclipse.

aurora_thread.name: Aurora Thread
aurora_thread.description: A threadlike strand of auroral energy that can be woven into liquid enchantments.

comet_dust.name: Comet Dust
comet_dust.description: Frozen particulate material shed from a passing comet.

eclipse_pearl.name: Eclipse Pearl
eclipse_pearl.description: A pearl formed where moonlight and shadow overlap during a total eclipse.

yesterdays_ash.name: Yesterday's Ash
yesterdays_ash.description: Ash from an event that has technically already happened tomorrow.

borrowed_second.name: Borrowed Second
borrowed_second.description: A stolen instant that briefly exists outside the normal flow of time.

yesterdays_rain.name: Yesterday's Rain
yesterdays_rain.description: Rainwater that remembers falling on a previous day.

clockwork_dust.name: Clockwork Dust
clockwork_dust.description: Microscopic brass-like particles shed by machines that have experienced time distortion.

frozen_moment.name: Frozen Moment
frozen_moment.description: A moment compressed into a crystalline state that can temporarily suspend a brewing process.

forgotten_thought.name: Forgotten Thought
forgotten_thought.description: A thought detached from its original owner and preserved as magical residue.

childhood_memory.name: Childhood Memory
childhood_memory.description: A warm fragment of remembered wonder preserved in a tiny glass bead.

false_memory.name: False Memory
false_memory.description: A memory that insists it happened despite having no history to support it.

unfinished_dream.name: Unfinished Dream
unfinished_dream.description: A dream fragment that changes whenever someone attempts to remember its ending.

candle_smoke.name: Candle Smoke
candle_smoke.description: Smoke collected from a candle that has burned long enough to become alchemically resonant.

fireplace_ember.name: Fireplace Ember
fireplace_ember.description: A long-lived ember collected from the apothecary fireplace.

midnight_dew.name: Midnight Dew
midnight_dew.description: Dew condensed during midnight rain beneath moonlight.

first_snow.name: First Snow
first_snow.description: The first snowflake of a season, collected before touching ordinary ground.

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.description: The magical residue of thunder captured at the instant lightning strikes.

mirror_fragment.name: Mirror Fragment
mirror_fragment.description: A mirror shard that reflects properties instead of faces.

broken_compass.name: Broken Compass
broken_compass.description: A compass whose needle points toward places that do not currently exist.

unwritten_page.name: Unwritten Page
unwritten_page.description: A blank page that records what might happen rather than what has happened.

key_without_a_lock.name: Key Without a Lock
key_without_a_lock.description: A key that unlocks hidden things even when no physical lock is present.

coin_from_nowhere.name: Coin From Nowhere
coin_from_nowhere.description: A coin that appears in the laboratory whenever nobody is looking directly at it.

last_whisper.name: Last Whisper
last_whisper.description: The final sound left behind after a conversation that nobody remembers having.

footstep.name: Footstep
footstep.description: A single footprint's sound, captured without the person who made it.

warmth.name: Warmth
warmth.description: The concept of warmth condensed into a harmless golden sensation.

silence.name: Silence
silence.description: The absence of sound given enough magical density to become tangible.

a_name.name: A Name
a_name.description: A word stripped of language and reduced to the magical concept of identity.

the_color_blue.name: The Color Blue
the_color_blue.description: Blue itself, temporarily separated from every object that normally displays it.

shadow_without_owner.name: A Shadow Without an Owner
shadow_without_owner.description: A shadow that persists despite having no object, person, or light source to justify it.

one_unused_wish.name: One Unused Wish
one_unused_wish.description: A single unrealized possibility condensed into magical potential.

the_last_drop.name: The Last Drop
the_last_drop.description: The final drop remaining in an otherwise empty container.

loaded_coin.name: Loaded Coin
loaded_coin.description: A suspiciously cooperative coin that slightly favors the brewer.

lucky_number.name: Lucky Number
lucky_number.description: A numerical concept that somehow exists as a tangible magical reagent.

liquid_metal.name: Liquid Metal
liquid_metal.description: Metal that remains liquid at ordinary laboratory temperatures.

glass_sand.name: Glass Sand
glass_sand.description: Sand with a partial crystalline structure caused by repeated magical heating.

magnetized_dust.name: Magnetized Dust
magnetized_dust.description: Metallic dust whose grains align themselves toward magical fields.

living_ink.name: Living Ink
living_ink.description: Ink that rearranges its symbols when exposed to new magical information.

memory_glass.name: Memory Glass
memory_glass.description: Glass capable of retaining a weak imprint of the properties of previous brews.

yggdrasil_seed.name: Yggdrasil Seed
yggdrasil_seed.description: A seed inspired by the mythic world-tree, carrying branching life-force resonance.

mimisbrunnr_water.name: Mímisbrunnr Water
mimisbrunnr_water.description: Water inspired by the legendary well associated with wisdom and hidden knowledge.

bifrost_fragment.name: Bifröst Fragment
bifrost_fragment.description: A crystalline fragment inspired by the mythic rainbow bridge between realms.

ambrosia.name: Ambrosia
ambrosia.description: A divine food-inspired reagent associated with extraordinary vitality.

golden_apple.name: Golden Apple
golden_apple.description: A myth-inspired golden fruit that intensifies competition, beauty, and desire.

styx_water.name: Styx Water
styx_water.description: A myth-inspired underworld water reagent that creates unusually strict magical boundaries.

eye_of_ra.name: Eye of Ra
eye_of_ra.description: A sun-associated relic inspired by Egyptian mythology and represented as a magical solar eye.

nile_pearl.name: Nile Pearl
nile_pearl.description: A pearl inspired by the Nile's association with life and abundance.

kitsune_ember.name: Kitsune Ember
kitsune_ember.description: A fox-spirit-inspired ember that encourages clever transformations.

yuki_crystal.name: Yuki Crystal
yuki_crystal.description: An icy crystal inspired by winter spirit folklore.

fairy_ring_dust.name: Fairy Ring Dust
fairy_ring_dust.description: Dust collected from a naturally occurring ring of enchanted mushrooms.

domovoi_ash.name: Domovoi Ash
domovoi_ash.description: House-spirit-inspired ash that strengthens mixtures associated with shelter and protection.

baba_yaga_chicken_leg_herb.name: Baba Yaga's Chicken-Leg Herb
baba_yaga_chicken_leg_herb.description: An absurdly mobile herb inspired by a legendary walking hut.

nether_quartz.name: Nether Quartz
nether_quartz.description: A red-world-inspired quartz crystal adapted into an original alchemical reagent.

chorus_fruit.name: Chorus Fruit
chorus_fruit.description: A teleportation-themed fruit adapted into an original spatial reagent.

glowstone_dust.name: Glowstone Dust
glowstone_dust.description: A bright mineral powder adapted into an original light-amplifying reagent.

fallen_star.name: Fallen Star
fallen_star.description: A star-shaped celestial fragment adapted into an original energy reagent.

deathweed.name: Deathweed
deathweed.description: A dangerous herb adapted into an original poison-and-curse reagent.

blinkroot.name: Blinkroot
blinkroot.description: A root adapted into an original short-range spatial reagent.

daybloom.name: Daybloom
daybloom.description: A daytime flower adapted into an original solar-growth reagent.

transmutation_residue.name: Transmutation Residue
transmutation_residue.description: The residue left when matter is rearranged without being fully converted into a new substance.

equivalent_ash.name: Equivalent Ash
equivalent_ash.description: Ash formed when a transmutation balances itself by consuming an equal measure of magical potential.

red_philosopher_crystal.name: Red Philosopher Crystal
red_philosopher_crystal.description: An original red crystal representing the apothecary's ideal of concentrated transformational potential.

steam.name: Steam
steam.description: A hot gaseous state produced when water and heat collide.

thermal_shock.name: Thermal Shock
thermal_shock.description: A violent reaction produced when extreme heat and cold occupy the same mixture.

eclipse_vapor.name: Eclipse Vapor
eclipse_vapor.description: A vapor produced when light and shadow are forced into temporary equilibrium.

void_magic.name: Void Magic
void_magic.description: A contradictory magical state formed when magic is exposed to void resonance.

unstable_healing.name: Unstable Healing
unstable_healing.description: A restorative reaction destabilized by contradictory toxic energy.

fertility_essence.name: Fertility Essence
fertility_essence.description: A rich growth essence formed when earth and life-producing properties reinforce one another.

radiance.name: Radiance
radiance.description: A luminous state produced when water carries concentrated light without boiling away.

combustion.name: Combustion
combustion.description: A concentrated energetic reaction produced when fire meets stored magical energy.

astral_residue.name: Astral Residue
astral_residue.description: Residue formed when dreams and spirits briefly align with celestial energy.

stormglass.name: Stormglass
stormglass.description: A glassy crystal formed when storm energy fuses airborne mineral dust.

blood_moon_residue.name: Blood Moon Residue
blood_moon_residue.description: A crimson lunar residue collected during a blood moon.

red_tide_dust.name: Red Tide Dust
red_tide_dust.description: Fine crimson dust left where blood-moon light touches enchanted water.

charged_rain.name: Charged Rain
charged_rain.description: Rain droplets carrying a temporary electrical charge from a thunderstorm.

alignment_aether.name: Alignment Aether
alignment_aether.description: Aether compressed during a rare alignment of celestial bodies.

astral_thread.name: Astral Thread
astral_thread.description: A thin filament linking magical matter to distant celestial resonance.

wildcards.description: Any liquid can partially substitute for water.
Any ingredient with sufficient light can partially substitute for Glowcap.
Any ingredient with sufficient fire can partially substitute for Emberroot.
Any ingredient with sufficient cooling can partially substitute for Frostpetal.
Earth-rich minerals can partially substitute for Rich Soil.
Strong energy ingredients can partially substitute for Thunder Seed.
Highly stable ingredients can act as weak stabilizers.
Dream-rich ingredients can partially substitute for Dream Mushroom.

amplifier.description: Increases the dominant property of a brew.

transformation_catalyst.description: Encourages ingredients to transform into emergent materials.

temporal_catalyst.description: Changes how brewing time is interpreted.

anti_magic_catalyst.description: Suppresses magical properties while strengthening physical interactions.

purification_catalyst.description: Removes some poison and curse effects.

discovery_catalyst.description: Improves the chance of discovering hidden experimental outcomes.

name_generation.rule: Names must be generated from dominant properties, interactions, and material states rather than unrelated random words.

validation_rules: all ingredient ids must be unique
all ingredient names must be unique
all ingredient types must exist in ingredient_types
all tags must exist in tags
all recipe ingredient references must resolve
all interaction result references must resolve
all event ingredient references must resolve
all catalyst ingredient references must resolve
all reference ingredient ids must resolve
rarity weights must be normalized by the resolver
ingredient count must be at least 150
JSON must parse successfully with JSON.parse
